items.stem: A manager says an AI tool 'understands our business'. What is the most accurate correction?

options.text: The tool predicts likely text from patterns in data; it has no understanding of your business
options.rationale: Correct: current AI produces statistically likely output, not genuine comprehension.

options.text: The tool has read and memorised your company handbook
options.rationale: It has not; it reflects training-data patterns, not stored company facts.

options.text: The tool reasons about your business like an experienced analyst
options.rationale: It mimics patterns and can be wrong; it does not reason from understanding.

options.text: The tool is always right about your business
options.rationale: Fluency is not accuracy; outputs can be confidently wrong.

items.explanation: Correct: current AI produces statistically likely output, not genuine comprehension.
items.domain_ref: What AI is and is not

items.stem: A team wants to adopt an AI feature responsibly. Which TWO practices support that? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Keep a human in the loop for consequential decisions
options.rationale: Correct: human oversight catches errors before they cause harm.

options.text: State the known limitations of the feature to users
options.rationale: Correct: communicating limits sets honest expectations.

options.text: Treat every AI output as final and authoritative
options.rationale: Unverified outputs can be wrong; this increases risk.

options.text: Hide that AI was used in the workflow
options.rationale: Lack of disclosure undermines trust and accountability.

items.explanation: Correct: human oversight catches errors before they cause harm.

items.stem: Which situation is the best fit for an AI tool?

options.text: A high-volume, repetitive task where some error is tolerable and checkable
options.rationale: Correct: AI suits scalable tasks where outputs can be reviewed.

options.text: A one-off legal decision with no tolerance for error
options.rationale: Low error tolerance and high stakes favour expert human judgement.

options.text: A task with no available data or examples
options.rationale: Without data the tool has nothing to learn from.

options.text: A task whose answer must be provably exact every time

items.explanation: Correct: AI suits scalable tasks where outputs can be reviewed.
